apex.config.custom-menu-block-guide.acce: Highlight colour for active tabs and buttons in menus that use the shared theme.
apex.config.custom-menu-block-guide.heig: Menu height in pixels at 100 % scale (0 = the menu's default).
apex.config.custom-menu-block-guide.mode: Apex: the Apex menu in front of Hypixel's chest. Normal: Hypixel's own chest.
apex.config.custom-menu-block-guide.rese: Put this menu back to Apex with its default size, scale and colour.
apex.config.custom-menu-block-guide.scal: Menu size in percent; it never grows past the screen.
apex.config.custom-menu-block-guide.widt: Menu width in pixels at 100 % scale (0 = the menu's default).
apex.config.custom-menu-enchant-guide.ac: Highlight colour for active tabs and buttons in menus that use the shared theme.
apex.config.custom-menu-enchant-guide.gr: Split each page into normal and Ultimate enchantments. Off: Hypixel's order.
apex.config.custom-menu-enchant-guide.he: Menu height in pixels at 100 % scale (0 = the menu's default).
apex.config.custom-menu-enchant-guide.mo: Apex: the Apex menu in front of Hypixel's chest. Normal: Hypixel's own chest.
apex.config.custom-menu-enchant-guide.re: Put this menu back to Apex with its default size, scale and colour.
apex.config.custom-menu-enchant-guide.sc: Menu size in percent; it never grows past the screen.
apex.config.custom-menu-enchant-guide.wi: Menu width in pixels at 100 % scale (0 = the menu's default).
